summary: Frontend-only retest (mobile 390x844, localStorage pet_user/pet_quiz_prefs cleared) of the 2 Quiz state bugs from iteration_3 plus regression of the full flow. BOTH BUGS ARE FIXED. Verified: name-only login (Mariana) -> quiz auto-opens -> 'Começar' -> 4 questions with Continuar/Voltar -> quiz-result with correct species badge (pet=cachorro -> '🐶 Cachorro', 'Frango com Ovo Cozido e Cenoura', Fácil, 25 min, main ingredients). BUG2: after 'Voltar ao início' the intro renders quiz-use-last-btn (count=1) and the primary button reads 'Refazer o quiz'; clicking 'Usar minhas últimas respostas' goes straight to quiz-result. BUG1: 'Ver receita' opens modal-recipe-detail, closing it and clicking refazer-quiz-btn reopens the quiz at the INTRO (quiz-result=0, quiz-start-btn=1, quiz-skip-btn=1). 'Escolher outra receita' closes the quiz (quiz-modal=0), applies catalog filters (results-count=(50) for gato+refeição, 50 cards rendered, grid non-empty), and reopening via refazer-quiz-btn again shows the intro, not the stale result. No console errors/warnings captured.

issues: Two close affordances overlap in the top-right: the custom quiz-close-btn (white X inside the green header) plus a faint default Dialog '×' rendered slightly above/right of it, partially clipped by the modal corner. Cosmetic only, both are inside the header area; consider hiding the shadcn DialogContent default close button.

action_items: Optional cosmetic: remove/hide the duplicate default DialogContent close '×' in the Quiz modal header (custom quiz-close-btn already exists).
critical_code_review_comments: Quiz.jsx fix is correct: savedPrefs is now state, useEffect on [open] resets step/answers/result, and finalize() refreshes savedPrefs from localStorage after writing - all three previously stale paths now behave.
Dashboard.jsx: showQuiz still defaults to true, so the quiz also reopens on every page reload (not only after login). Confirm this is intended UX; otherwise gate it on a session flag.
seed_data_creation: None - name-only login as 'Mariana'; pet_quiz_prefs written by the quiz itself
test_credentials: Name-only login; used 'Mariana' (no credentials file required)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_3's two Quiz state bugs (stale result on reopen; missing quiz-use-last-btn after 'Voltar ao início') are fixed and verified on mobile 390x844. Test flow: clear localStorage (pet_user, pet_quiz_prefs) -> reload -> fill first input with a name -> submit -> quiz auto-opens. Only a cosmetic duplicate close-button in the quiz header remains.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous defects were local state lifecycle issues in Quiz.jsx (savedPrefs memoized on [open]; close paths bypassing reset()). The fix moved savedPrefs to state, added a reset effect keyed on the `open` prop, and made Dashboard close the quiz on onOpenRecipe/onApplyFilters - so every reopen remounts the intro with fresh prefs.
